newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish KPW clears Elektromontaz Warszawa shares.
newsitem.headline: Polish KPW clears Elektromontaz Warszawa shares.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission has cleared the shares of construction and engineering company Elektromontaz Warszawa for public trade, the commission head told a news conference.
The commission cleared the existing 6,915,500 shares and a 1,750,000 share new issue scheduled for November 18 to November 23.

The president of the company said the minimum issue price will be 3.5 zlotys, but the final strike price would determined on the basis of the received bids. He also said the firm, which wanted to enter the parallel market of the bourse planned to move to the main market in the future.
"Our goal is to reach the main market, but for the time being we only fulfil the requirements of the parallel market," Wojciech Stelmach told Reuters.
Elektromontaz Warszawa, which had a net profit of 1.4 million zlotys on sales of 42.4 million zlotys last year, expected to earn 1.8 million zlotys in 1996.
In the first eight months of 1996 the company earned 1.4 million zlotys.
